messages:
emily_sales: FYI FinBank legal requested a minimal compliance bundle for the POC kicking off Monday. Required: SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert screenshot, signed pen-test attestation (must name test window + state no outstanding criticals), 1-page network diagram, and staging access steps. Theyalso asked if Dedicated supports single-tenant isolation and what the uplift is. Can we turn a lean package + draft attestation by EOD?

raj_seccops: Yes. I'll assemble a redacted SOC2 summary, ISO screenshot, and a draft pen-test letter for Head of Security signature. Will note scope limited to tested env and include the exact paragraph about "no outstanding critical vulnerabilities". ETA EOD.

noah_eng: I'll make a simple network diagram and a 1-paragraph blast-radius note. Staging access will be ephemeral read-only creds (TTL 7d). Snippet I'll include: `./infra/tools/create-staging-creds --project finbank-poc --role read-only --ttl 7d` plus sample allowed-endpoints JSON.

paul_ps: Dedicated single-tenant (reserved GPU pool + VPC peering) is supported. For a short POC the uplift is roughly +25-35% depending on GPU. I'll DM precise numbers to @emily_sales for the quote.

emily_sales: Legal wants the attestation language to explicitly include the testing dates and confirm no outstanding criticals at issuance. Raj, can you include that in the draft?

raj_seccops: Draft template below, will send to Legal for signature: ```
[Redwood Letterhead]
Date: [MM/DD/YYYY]
To: [Customer]
Subject: Penetration Test Attestation

Redwood Inference engaged [3rd-party vendor] to perform a penetration test covering the scoped production and staging components between [start date] and [end date]. At the time this letter was issued there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities identified in the scoped systems that would materially impact confidentiality, integrity, or availability.

Signed,
[Head of Security]
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
```

I'll escalate to Legal for approval and signature.

evidence_bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: https://box.internal/redwood/finbank-poc-evidence-v1.zip (permissions: sales+security). :package:

emily_sales: Great. I'll send bundle to FinBank and flag that signed attestation is pending signature by Legal. If they push for SaaS-wide attestation we'll ask for a separate request.

[thread closed]
